latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: AI-powered video editing with fast cloud processing.

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, MXF, up to 500MB) and describe edits with natural language.
- Automatic session setup using a free, temporary anonymous token.
- Supports common editing commands: cut dead air, add transitions, sync audio, and more.
- Export polished 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- Check status, credits, and manage sessions directly through chat prompts.
- Built for creators who want fast, professional results without manual Adobe Premiere editing.
